source.note: Written in a Claude Code session from the bible and pipeline prompt (no API key available); validated with src/dialogue/validate.ts.

greeting: Evening, Inspector. Shocking business about {victim}. Can't say I'm surprised nobody saw nothing.
Stewards see everything, Inspector. Nobody looks at us long enough to notice. Ask away.
{Victim.full}. Brought {victim.object} a tray this morning. Never guessed it'd be the last.
Pull up a chair, sir. Don't mind me, I'm only the help. Funny how the help always ends up answering the questions.
Right, Inspector. I'll tell you what I know, and I know a fair bit. Comes with the job.
Terrible thing. And on the last night, too. Half the tips in this job come on the last night.
whereabouts: I was {room}, {time}. Steward goes where he's sent.
{Time} I was {room}. You can put that in your little book.
I was {room} {time}, near as makes no odds.
{RoomName}. {Time}, give or take. They don't issue us pocket watches, see.
sawOne: {Other} was there. Didn't so much as nod, mind. They never do.
Just {other}, sir. Very interesting, what people get up to when they think nobody's looking.
I saw {other}. Gave {other.object} a nod. Got nothing back. Usual.
{Other}. I'll say no more. Well. I might, later.
There was {other}, Inspector. Ask {other.object} what {other.subject} was doing; I'd like to know an' all.
Only {other}. Looked at me like I was a coat stand.
sawSeveral: {Others} were there. Not a tip between 'em.
I saw {others}. All on their best behaviour, which is how I know they weren't.
{Others}, sir. Like a Lyons tea shop on a Saturday.
{Others}. I kept me head down and me ears open.
Let's see: {others}. None of 'em noticed me, naturally.
sawVictim: {Victim} was there, sir. Right as rain. Makes you think.
I saw {victim}. Asked if {victim.subject} wanted anything. {Victim.subject} said no. Last thing {victim.subject} ever said to me.
{Victim}, yeah. Looked like {victim.subject} had something on {victim.possessive} mind. People get a look.
I saw {victim}, Inspector. Wish I'd hung about a bit longer, now.
{Victim} was there. Alive and kicking. Well. Alive.
Yeah, {victim}. Not a care in the world, by the look of it. Shows what looks are worth.
sawNoOne: No one, sir. Quiet as a church.
Not a soul, Inspector. Rare, on this ship.
No one. Shocking, I know. A steward with nobody to fetch for.
Nobody at all, sir. Not even a bell ringing.
Didn't see a living soul. Not one.
confrontCrack: {Witness} said that, did {witness.subject}? Right. Fair enough. You'd best sit down, Inspector.
Ah. Caught bang to rights. Go on, then, I'll tell you.
Should've known {witness} would give me away. Can't fool everybody. Here's how it was.
All right, all right. Just don't tell the purser, eh?
confrontDeflect: Begging your pardon, but {witness} has got it wrong, sir.
{Witness}? {Witness.subject} wouldn't know me from the next fella in a white jacket.
I've told you straight, Inspector. I ain't changing it.
With respect, {witness} sees what {witness.subject} wants to. My story stands.
accusedWrongly: Me? With {weapon}? Leave off, Inspector. I'd lose my job.
I never touched {victim}. Steward's word. Whatever that's worth to you lot.
Course it's the steward. It's always the steward, ain't it? Well, not this time.
Begging your pardon, sir, but that's a lie, and a lazy one.
accusedRightly: Yeah. {Weapon}. {Victim.subject} found out about the game below decks and said {victim.subject}'d have me sacked. Sacked, Inspector.
Fair play to you, Inspector. {RoomName}. Didn't think anyone ever looked at a steward that close.
Six days of keeping my head down, Inspector, and {victim} was going to have me sacked over the cards. One second, and it was done.
All right. It was me, with {weapon}. This job's all I've got, sir. Turns out I'd do anything to keep it.
accusedPartly: Yeah, it was me. Not how you said, though. {Weapon}, {room}. Might as well have it right.
Fair play, you got me. Got the rest wrong, mind. {Weapon}, {room}.
All right. I did it. But it was {weapon}, sir, {room}. Steward notices these things.
It was me. {Weapon}, though, {room}. Funny, the bits people get wrong.
opinion.marble: {Other}? Never tipped me once. Cold as {other.possessive} own marble, that one.
I'm ever so polite to {other}, sir. Drives {other.object} up the wall.
{Other.subject} talks big. But I've seen {other.object} counting coins in the corridor when {other.subject} thinks nobody's about.
opinion.folder: {Other}? My guv'nor. Very particular. Very, very particular.
{Other.subject} watches me like a hawk. I give {other.object} my best smile, every time.
Between you and me, {other} spends a lot of late nights over them ledgers. Make of that what you will.
opinion.mallet: {Other}? Good sort. Straight as a die. I rigged {other.object} up a lawn on the boat deck.
{Other.subject} don't suffer fools. Suits me; I'm no fool.
{Other} shouts a lot, but {other.subject} says please. More than most in first class do.
opinion.bear: {Other.subject} has a crate down below that ain't on any manifest, sir. Not that I've looked.
{Other} talks the hind leg off a donkey, but {other.subject}'s got a heart of gold.
opinion.egg: {Other}? Sweet kid. Far too nervous. I bring {other.object} ginger biscuits for the sea.
{Other.subject} goes red every time I say good morning. Must be the seasickness.
{Other} scribbles in that notebook all day. Wouldn't mind a peek, if I'm honest.
eulogy.marble: {Other}. Can't pretend I liked {other.object}, sir. Don't wish it on anyone, though.
Never tipped once in six days. Now {other.subject} never will. Sorry. That came out wrong.
{Other.subject} had enemies. Men like that always do. Question is which one.
eulogy.folder: {Other}. My guv'nor. Stickler, but fair. Mostly.
{Other.subject} was always on at me. Funny how quiet it is without it.
Somebody'll have to do {other.possessive} ledgers. Not me, I can tell you that.
eulogy.mallet: {Other}? No. Not {other.object}. Straight as a die, {other.subject} was.
I built {other.object} that lawn. Spent two nights on it. Don't know what to do with it now.
{Other.subject} trusted me. Not many do. I'll find who did this if you don't.
eulogy.bear: {Other}. Ah, that's rotten. Kindest lady aboard.
Tipped like a duchess and talked like a gramophone. I'll miss the both.
{Other.subject} knew everybody's business. Somebody didn't like that.
eulogy.egg: {Other}? That sweet kid? Who'd do that?
Brought {other.object} biscuits only this morning. {Other.subject} said thank you twice. Always did.
{Other.subject} was scared of everything. Turns out {other.subject} was right to be.
